description: This Java class 'SubscriptionsReader' manages local subscription data, providing methods to retrieve subscribers for given topics, check topic subscriptions, and handle subscription data immutably.

classes.name: SubscriptionsReader
classes.description: A final class that provides read-only access to subscription data, including retrieving subscribers for topics and checking topic subscriptions.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty SubscriptionsReader instance with no subscriptions.

methods.name: fromImmutableMaps
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionsReader from immutable maps of topics to subscribers and subscribers to filters.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves a set of subscribers for the provided collection of topics, applying subscriber filters.

methods.name: containsTopic
methods.description: Checks if a specific topic has any subscribers.
